topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just found out that my best friend is moving across the country. I've been thinking about how this might be an amazing opportunity for them, a fresh start, really. I mean, new places, new people, new everything. But the more I think about it, the more my mind keeps going back to all the times we've been there for each other, the inside jokes, the shared silences. I'm trying to focus on the positive, how this move could open up so many doors for them. I just hope they know, no matter the distance, I'm still here for them. It's just, it feels like everything is changing, and I wish I could do more to support them through this, like how they've always been there for me.
